messages:
anna: Heads-up — opened PR #4721 to add a migration/deprecation section for the legacy tiering headers on the rate-limits page. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4721

tamika: Nice, thanks. Do you have concrete SDK snippets for Python/Node? We should show both old -> new examples so customers can copy-paste.

anna: Yep — added short snippets at the bottom of the page. Python example: `headers = {\"x-redwood-tier\": \"v2\"}` and Node/Fetch: `fetch(url, { headers: { 'x-redwood-tier': 'v2' } })`. Also included a short migration note about fallback semantics.

david: Quick request — can we add a tiny graf panel screenshot showing the `billing.tier_assigned` metric? I worry folks won't find the dashboard mapping.

anna: Good call. I pushed a placeholder image `tier-panel.png` and pinged design for an export at 320x180. Will replace once they send it.

samir: Flagging that Dedicated customers have slightly different quota semantics (reserve vs burst). I added a short sidenote but it probably needs engineering sign-off. @ryan can you sanity-check wording?

ryan: Reviewed the Dedicated note — tweak needed: change phrase \"unlimited burst\" -> \"burst up to reserve capacity\". Also clarify that reserve is consumed before burst. I'll push a tiny copy edit.

jules: Heads-up from SDK side: this header change is in python-sdk v0.9.2; we should include a migration snippet and a deprecation banner at the top of the docs page so customers know to pin SDK versions.

anna: Added a deprecation banner (yellow) and a short migration table. Can someone run a quick smoke against staging? Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits/headers

tamika: Running smoke now. Note: older SDKs treat headers case-insensitively in some clients; we should recommend lowercased `x-redwood-tier` in snippets to avoid mismatch. I'll also validate the python example uses `from redwood import Client` pattern.

samir: Test note: I saw a failure when header was uppercase in a curl example — added an inline tip: \"use lowercase `x-redwood-tier` to be compatible with older clients\".

ryan: Pushed the copy fix for Dedicated wording. @tamika can you re-run? If staging is green I'll approve the PR.

tamika: :thumbsup: re-running tests and manual check. I updated the python snippet to show `client = Client(api_key=...)` usage so it's easier for customers.

docs-bot: Deploy preview posted: https://deploy-preview-4721--docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits/headers (preview expires in 7 days).

tamika: Looks good to me on staging. Merging in 5m if no objections.

anna: :tada: thanks team — after merge I'll open a follow-up to add the final dashboard panel image and a short Private/air-gapped privacy note for the header migration.
